summary: SEC-002/003/004 verified. Extended pytest suite: 41 total (18 new in test_iter_sec002_003_004.py + 23 existing in test_iter_fateactions_and_checkin.py). 40/41 pass on a clean run; the single failure (TestAdmin.test_login_and_verify) is a KNOWN environment-side effect of iter1's TestCheckin.test_rate_limit_60_per_min hammering 80 rapid POSTs against the shared per-IP bucket (`_RL_BUCKETS[ip]` in core.rate_limit is keyed only by IP, so it globally spikes the count across ALL rate-limited routes on the same worker for the 60s window). Re-tested admin login in isolation after cooldown: 200 OK (confirmed via curl). Not an app regression. SEC-002 verification matrix (a-f) all pass: verified=true is stripped server-side unless _gps_checkin_count(code) >= stops with only source='gps' counting; impossible-pace >15mph still downgrades; missing code -> unverified; manual check-ins do NOT count. SEC-002 idempotency: 5 repeated POSTs -> exactly 1 doc; gps+manual for same stop_id -> 2 docs (different source); created_at unchanged on repost, expire_at refreshed. TTL indexes intact (expire_at_1 expireAfterSeconds=0, code_1). SEC-003: origin_allowed default returns True for fork-fate.com, www.fork-fate.com, preview.emergentagent.com and False for evil.com; subprocess reimport with ALLOW_PREVIEW_ORIGINS=false correctly drops the preview wildcard while keeping fork-fate.com allowed. SEC-004: /places/photo returns 404 without GOOGLE_API_KEY, rejects path-traversal/malformed names, cache constants importable from core, code inspection confirms _google_reserve() precedes the httpx fetch on miss and X-Photo-Cache header is set to 'hit'/'miss' on the respective branches, eviction branch present. Build: FF_BUILD="2026.06-280" present. Cleanup: no imports of CheckInButton in /app/frontend/src/**/*.jsx and /app/frontend/src/components/CheckInButton.jsx does not exist. Frontend PubCrawlDialog wiring code-verified: buildStopsPayload, ensureCrawlCode (creatingRef dedupe), postCheckin (postedRef Set with retry-on-failure), MANUAL_MIN_GAP_MS=30000, shareCrawl calls ensureCrawlCode -> one code per session for both check-ins and share link.

minor.issue: The in-memory per-IP bucket _RL_BUCKETS is keyed only by IP, not by (IP, route), so a burst on one rate-limited route (e.g. /crawls/{code}/checkin, 60/min) consumes the budget of every other rate-limited route (/crawls at 30/min, /admin/login at 30/min) on the same worker for the sliding 60s window. This surfaces as flaky 429s in the pytest suite when tests share an IP. Pre-existing (iter1), out of iter2 scope, but worth noting for the audit's per-worker rate limiter P3.

critical_code_review_comments: crawls.complete_crawl correctly discards client-provided verified=True when server-side GPS count < stops, then still applies the >15mph downgrade — order is right (auth first, then physics).

record_checkin uses upsert with $setOnInsert for created_at and $set for expire_at, which is exactly right for TTL refresh + immutable creation timestamp; key is (code, stop_id, source) so gps and manual don't collide.
_gps_checkin_count uses distinct() on stop_id with source='gps' filter — cannot be inflated even if the upsert regressed, defense-in-depth.

core.ALLOWED_ORIGIN_REGEX is built once at import time from ALLOW_PREVIEW_ORIGINS; the compiled _ORIGIN_RE is used everywhere. The env-gate design (default True) preserves preview while giving prod a clean opt-out.

places.places_photo reserves against _google_reserve() BEFORE httpx.get on cache miss (SEC-004 intent), returns X-Photo-Cache 'hit'/'miss' correctly, and skips caching for responses > _PHOTO_CACHE_MAX_BYTES.

PubCrawlDialog.ensureCrawlCode dedupes concurrent callers via creatingRef promise, and postCheckin's postedRef.delete(key) on failure allows a retry — good; also removes the risk of a failed check-in silently blocking the checkbox toggle (fire-and-forget catch block wraps the post).

Preview ingress (Cloudflare) rewrites ACAO to '*' with allow-credentials:true on all responses regardless of origin. This is an infrastructure-layer concern, not the app's CORSMiddleware behavior (which is correctly restricted via ALLOWED_ORIGIN_REGEX). Browsers reject '*'+credentials, so it's not an exploitable open CORS in practice, but it does mask the app's own origin gating over the wire in this preview. Flagging for the ops layer, not for E1.

success_rate.backend: 97.5% (40/41 in one run; the 1 failure is a shared-IP rate-limit bleed from iter1's stress test, admin login re-verified 200 OK in isolation)
success_rate.frontend: Code-verified 100% for the PubCrawlDialog wiring helpers (ensureCrawlCode/postCheckin/buildStopsPayload); end-to-end UI drive-through the dialog was not completed via Playwright because the Plan a Crawl entry requires bars mode + Pub Crawls toggle + scroll + button click and hit the 3-attempt loop guard. Backend endpoints exercised by the dialog are fully covered by pytest.

seed_data_creation: Test crawl created with label='TEST_sec2' and stop_ids TS1/TS2/TS3/TS_upsert/TS_dual/TS_ttl. Auto-cleaned in session teardown (crawls, crawl_checkins, crawl_completions matching TEST_sec2 / ^TS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest addopts pins -n 2 --dist loadscope from /app/backend/pytest.ini — run serial with `-n 0` (NOT `-p no:xdist`). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported before running because tests assert on it. The rate-limit test in test_iter_fateactions_and_checkin.py::TestCheckin::test_rate_limit_60_per_min will poison the shared per-IP bucket for ~60s on the ingress-observed IP, causing 429s on any admin/crawl POST that runs immediately after — schedule that test last or add a 65s cooldown before other suites. Frontend crawl dialog navigation path: Skip intro -> click 'Bars' pill -> fill ZIP placeholder -> scroll down ~1500px -> ensure 'Pub Crawls & more' toggle is on -> click 'Plan a Crawl' button -> wait ~7s for the plan modal to render.
